title: Celestial Forest Biome
description: A mystical biome featuring floating islands, luminous trees, and rare magical resources.

gallery.title: Celestial Canopy
gallery.caption: Luminous leaves shimmer with faint violet and blue hues in the twilight.

author: Aetheria World Gen Team
behaviorBullets: Generates at higher elevations above Y: 120 as floating island chains
Luminous trees emit permanent light level 10 to ward off regular hostile mobs
Magical springs restore 1 health point per second to players who stand in them
Celestial Vines can be harvested and woven into extremely durable climbing ropes

sections.title: Biome Overview & Exploration
sections.content:
The **Celestial Forest** is an enchanting floating ecosystem that represents the pinnacle of the Sky Realms. High above the ground, these islands are tethered together by giant celestial vines.

- **Zero-Gravity Pockets:** Some valleys feature micro-gravity where players jump 2x higher.
- **Luminescent Flora:** Luminous trees illuminate the night and provide celestial wood.
- **Floating Ruins:** Ancient altars containing celestial maps and rare runes can be found scattered across major islands.
